Chapter 558: Chapter 10 Goodwill from the ‘Ancient God’ (Please Subscribe)_2

“What a great harvest…” Lin Yuan’s mind sank deep into his brain, looking at the new world coordinate imprint at the bottom of the Door to the Myriad Realms, a smile emerging on his face.

This time entering the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, Lin Yuan’s goal was for that ‘calling sensation.’

But unexpectedly, there was a pleasant surprise—he actually recorded a world coordinate from another dimensional layer?

World coordinates of other dimensional layers are useless to any powerful being, even to a Supreme Being.

They are of no use.

Without the ability to break through the dimensional barriers, what use is just a world coordinate?

...

But Lin Yuan is different; with the help of the Door to the Myriad Realms, he can easily descend to any world, no matter how many dimensions or layers are apart.

What even a Supreme Being cannot do, Lin Yuan can achieve with just a strand of World-Breaking Origin Force.

Of course, a strand of World-Breaking Origin Force only allows Lin Yuan to traverse randomly, and as Lin Yuan grows stronger, the downsides of random traversal also increase.

As a First Rank and Second Rank, no matter which world he descended to, he could bring tremendous help to himself.

Because his strength was too low, his upper limit for improvement was very high.

But at Fifth Rank, Sixth Rank, Eighth Rank, Ninth Rank… the worlds that could offer help to Lin Yuan were increasingly fewer.

That’s why on the eighth traversal, Lin Yuan directly chose the ‘Spirit Realm’ instead of aimlessly traversing.

What if, like the seventh traversal, he descended into a Low Martial World, unable to recover to Sixth Rank or manifest Physical Body Divine Ability? Wouldn’t that be a waste of World-Breaking Origin Force?

“Let’s see what kind of level the world connected to this coordinate is…”

Lin Yuan scrutinized the world coordinate at the bottom of the Door to the Myriad Realms.

He was quite anticipative about the world behind this coordinate, as the master of this opportunistic place in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm was a follower of that great ‘His Majesty.’

And how weak could a follower of a Supreme Being be?

From this, one could infer that the hometown world of the owner of the site of opportunity couldn’t possibly be of a low level.

If it were too low, likely it would be crushed to dust by the aura inside before even passing through the dimensional gap.

Hum!

Lin Yuan sent out a strand of his mind along the world coordinate, stepping into the dimensional layer and arriving beside a vast world.

“This world…”

Lin Yuan observed carefully. At this moment, his vision was the perspective of the Door to the Myriad Realms, allowing him to see many things invisible to himself.

Before the last traversal, when Lin Yuan observed the Spirit Realm, he also saw the ‘Immortal Realm’ above the Spirit Realm.

It’s known that the Immortal Realm and the Spirit Realm are not on the same spatial layer, only the Ninth Layer of Heaven of the Spirit Realm connects with the spatial layer where the Immortal Realm resides.

A moment later.

This strand of Lin Yuan’s mind extinguished.

“This world…compared to the Main World, the pace of time is roughly one to two or three hundred?”

Lin Yuan speculated in his thoughts.

Through the pace of time, he discerned that this world’s level must be much stronger than the Spirit Realm, which had a time flow rate comparison of five hundred to one with the Main Universe.

Although using only the pace of time to judge the strength of a world is somewhat arbitrary, it largely reflects the depth of the world’s foundation.

“And this world, it seems a bit special…” Lin Yuan’s expression showed he was deep in thought.

“For the ninth traversal, I can prioritize descending into this world.” Lin Yuan decided in his heart.

Although he has the world coordinate of the Immortal Realm, there exist beings comparable to Supreme Beings in the Immortal Realm such as the ‘Ancestral Master.’

Apart from the ‘Ancestral Master,’ Lin Yuan doesn’t know if there are other ancestors of the Great Dao.

The level of the Immortal Realm is a bit too high for Lin Yuan. If he reaches Tier 10 or Tier 11 in the future, Lin Yuan would consider descending into the Immortal Realm.

But for his current Ninth Rank? He’s more satisfied with the newly discovered world.

…

In the territory of the Tianyu Clan.

On a gigantic planet.

The strongest lifeform of the Ninth Rank of the Tianyu Clan, Hunyi, opened his eyes.

“Where exactly in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm is that Galactic Star Lord?”

Hunyi frowned slightly; upon learning that the Galactic Star Lord had also entered the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, he immediately began searching for traces of the other.

In Battlefield B0001, the Galactic Star Lord slaughtered those invincible Eighth Rank of the Tianyu Clan like chickens, a humiliation that enraged countless powerhouses of the Tianyu Clan.

Hunyi was no exception.

In the Main Universe, where the Galactic Star Lord was within the territory of the human race under the watchful eyes of a Supreme Being, Hunyi had no opportunity to make a move.

Even if in the future on a Large Alien Battlefield… it’s still uncertain whether human civilization would be willing to let the Galactic Star Lord enter such a battlefield.

And even if they allow it, they would definitely prepare many fallback strategies for the Galactic Star Lord.

Hunyi likewise had no assurance of dealing with the Galactic Star Lord.

But in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm… Hunyi believed he could definitely deal with the Galactic Star Lord.

“Hmm?”

“Has any powerhouse seen the Galactic Star Master exchange blows with Maduo Traveler?”

Hunyi immediately started contacting Maduo Traveler.

The Tianyu Clan had a good relationship with that ‘Ancient God’ Ancestor of Maduo Traveler, and several Heavenly Lords were close friends of the other party.

Before long,

the projection of Maduo Traveler appeared in front of Hunyi.

“Maduo.”

Hunyi looked at Maduo Traveler, “I heard you’ve had an exchange with the Galactic Star Master?”

“Some time ago, I indeed had an encounter with the Galactic Star Master over a treasure,” Maduo Traveler did not deny.

“Since you’ve had an encounter, I presume with your methods, Maduo, you should be able to roughly pinpoint the Galactic Star Master’s location using the rules of causality?”

Hunyi continued asking.

Maduo Traveler had directly confronted the Galactic Star Master, generating significant causality. By leveraging the connection between causality, one could roughly pinpoint the opponent’s location.

Of course, such pinpointing had to be among equals in terms of power realm.

If those defeated Tianyu Clan Eighth Rank invincibles attacked by Lin Yuan were to try pinpointing… Using Eighth Rank to lock onto Ninth Rank causality, whether it could be done wasn’t the issue, there would also be a backlash from causality.

“This…”

Maduo Traveler hesitated a bit.

“Rest assured, just tell me the range of the Galactic Star Master’s location, and I, Hunyi, will definitely reward you generously,” Hunyi said with a serious tone.

“Hunyi, it’s not that I don’t want to tell you.”

“It’s really that I don’t know; that Galactic Star Master is also profoundly skilled in the rules of causality, and I am unable to pinpoint him,” Maduo Traveler shook his head.

“Even more skilled in causality than you?” Hunyi asked, surprised.

“Yes.”

Maduo Traveler nodded.

“If that’s the case, then let it be,”

Hunyi was not suspicious of anything.

He cut off the connection with Maduo Traveler.

Elsewhere in the universe,

Maduo Traveler saw Hunyi’s projection disappear.

He breathed a sigh of relief.

“Ancestor.”

“Is it really okay for us to deceive Hunyi like this?”

Maduo Traveler looked towards the side, where an even more colossal figure was sitting.

It was Maduo Traveler’s ‘Ancient God’ Ancestor.

After the encounter with Lin Yuan, Maduo Traveler had informed his Ancestor about everything.

He felt Lin Yuan’s talent was too terrifying, and even though he disclosed information about Hunyi, he still felt uneasy and needed his Ancestor to consult.

Just now, while Hunyi contacted him, Maduo Traveler was considering whether to agree with Hunyi—

After all, Hunyi hailed from the Tianyu Clan, and was the strongest Ninth Layer being of his generation in the clan, possibly becoming a Heavenly Lord in the future.

But before Maduo Traveler could decide, the Ancient God Ancestor next to him gestured for him not to disclose the whereabouts of the Galactic Star Master.

“Deceiving? What do you mean by deceiving?”

The Ancient God Ancestor glared at Maduo Traveler, “What have I, your Ancestor, relied on in all my time traversing the universe?”

“It’s relying on insight!”

The Ancient God Ancestor spoke gravely, “The strength of that Galactic Star Master, if really as you described, surpasses even the rumors, how long has he stepped into the Ninth Rank and already possessed the strength to repel you?”

“But Hunyi…”

Maduo Traveler was still a bit worried.

He used the excuse that the Galactic Star Master was also skilled in causality to refuse Hunyi, something that could be easily proven… It only needed another Ninth Rank powerhouse skilled in causality who had fought with the Galactic Star Master to emerge.

Then by using Causal Sensing, they could verify if the Galactic Star Master really had mastery in causality.

Maduo Traveler was worried that if Hunyi found out he was merely placating him…

“But what?”

The Ancient God Ancestor rolled his eyes, “That Hunyi, at most, is entering the Tenth Tier, but the Galactic Star Master is very likely to step into Tier 11, given the importance Human Civilization places on him, perhaps even aiming for that level.”

“If you offend Hunyi, your Ancestor here could still protect you.”

The Ancient God Ancestor glanced at Maduo Traveler.

“But if you offend the Galactic Star Master, I, your Ancestor, might even be implicated by you in the future…”
